objective: Implement clamp for values below, within, and above the inclusive range. Bounds are ordered.
initial: pub fn clamp(x: i32, _: i32, _: i32) -> i32 { x }
expected: pub fn clamp(x: i32, low: i32, high: i32) -> i32 { x.clamp(low, high) }
proposals: pub fn clamp(x: i32, low: i32, _: i32) -> i32 { x.max(low) }
pub fn clamp(x: i32, low: i32, high: i32) -> i32 { x.max(low).min(high) }
